name: pi-acp
description: ACP v1 adapter for Pi Agent, built on Pi's RPC mode

scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && RUN_PI_E2E=true vitest run --no-file-parallelism src/__tests__/e2e
scripts.package: bun run build && cp dist/index.js dist/pi-acp && chmod +x dist/pi-acp && rm -f dist/pi-acp.zip && zip -j dist/pi-acp.zip dist/pi-acp LICENSE NOTICE
